name: BeyondRxAid
description: HIPAA-compliant healthcare prescription management platform, fully rebuilt from MVC to ASP.NET Core 9 with real-time SignalR notifications and AWS KMS encryption.

caseStudy.subtitle: HIPAA-compliant healthcare prescription management platform — rebuilt from the ground up.
caseStudy.stack: ASP.NET Core 9, SQL Server, Redis, AWS KMS, Docker, SignalR
caseStudy.overview: BeyondRxAid began as a tightly coupled ASP.NET MVC 5 monolith with no caching layer, no background processing, and a deployment pipeline that required manual IIS restarts. The goal was to rebuild it into a maintainable, HIPAA-compliant system while keeping the existing user base uninterrupted — migrating data, re-architecting service boundaries, and introducing cloud infrastructure without a single extended downtime window.

contributions.title: Security & HIPAA compliance
points: Implemented AWS KMS envelope encryption for all PHI fields stored in SQL Server, covering data-at-rest compliance without full-disk overhead.
Built a custom ASP.NET Core middleware layer that intercepts every request touching protected health information and writes structured entries to an append-only audit log.
Introduced a consent management service with versioned records, letting the legal team roll out updated privacy policies without developer involvement.
Replaced plaintext configuration values with AWS Secrets Manager, removing all credentials from source control and CI pipelines.

contributions.title: Performance & caching
points: Integrated Redis in dual mode — a distributed cache for read-heavy prescription lookups (10× latency improvement) and a pub/sub backbone for real-time status events.
Used EFCore.BulkExtensions for batch prescription imports, cutting a 45-second bulk insert down to under 3 seconds for 10,000-row payloads.
Added response compression and HTTP/2 server push for static assets, reducing time-to-first-byte on the patient portal by roughly 40%.

contributions.title: Background processing
points: Replaced ad-hoc fire-and-forget Task.Run calls with Quartz.NET, giving every background job persistence, retry logic, and a scheduling dashboard.
Built a SignalR hub that pushes prescription status changes to connected patients in real time, eliminating a 30-second polling loop.
Separated long-running PDF generation into a dedicated worker service so it no longer blocks the main API thread pool under load.

contributions.title: Infrastructure & DevOps
points: Authored a multi-stage Dockerfile that reduced the final image from 1.8 GB to 220 MB.
Set up GitHub Container Registry with Actions workflows for build, test, security scanning, and deploy.
Deployed to AWS ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer, with auto-scaling tied to CPU and active SignalR connection count.
Implemented blue-green deployment for zero-downtime releases, validated with smoke tests before traffic cutover.

beforeAfter.before: Manual IIS restart on bare metal
